channel.desc: It's ladies day at the races. Cat has to make a speech, and it forces her to confront what she's been denying about her relationship with Dylan. Ollie misbehaves. With alcohol and adrenaline in the air, it's not long before rivalries are stirred up and best behaviour gives way to chaos. Shannon and Arran are caught in the crossfire as their families violently collide.
